en.headline: Barminski cardboard airport show runs at JPS Gallery until 19 September
en.dek: Runway 51 turns the Staunton Street gallery into a life-size cardboard terminal; admission is free, and the space is open Tuesday to Saturday.
body: American artist Barminski's immersive exhibition Runway 51 remains on view at JPS Gallery in Central through 19 September, the gallery said.

The ground-floor rooms at 88-90 Staunton Street have been fitted out as a full-scale cardboard airport, with a security checkpoint, departure hall and other terminal spaces drawn in black line on brown board. Visitors are issued a boarding pass on arrival. The title nods to the US military site known as Area 51.

The presentation follows Barminski's 2023 cardboard show at the same gallery. Opening hours listed by the organiser are 11am to 7pm, Tuesday to Saturday; the gallery is closed on Sundays, Mondays and public holidays. Admission is free.
The exhibition opened on 17 July. Practical details are those published by JPS Gallery; no ticket booking is required.

zh.headline: Barminski紙皮機場展於中環JPS畫廊展至9月19日
zh.dek: 《51號跑道》把士丹頓街畫廊改成一比一紙皮航廈，免費入場，開放時間為周二至六上午11時至晚上7時。
body: 美國藝術家Barminski的沉浸式展覽《51號跑道》（Runway 51）繼續在中環JPS畫廊展出，至9月19日結束，畫廊公布。
士丹頓街88至90號地下空間被改裝成一比一紙皮機場，設安檢站、候機大堂等以牛皮紙及黑線繪成的場景，入場者獲發登機證。展覽名稱呼應美國軍方51區。
今次是Barminski繼2023年後再於同一畫廊以紙皮裝置展出。主辦單位列出開放時間為周二至六上午11時至晚上7時，週日、周一及公眾假期休息，免費入場。
展覽於7月17日開幕。上述場地、日期及時間以JPS畫廊公布為準，毋須購票。
